interface.comment: light barrier at the start of the belt
interface.name: boxAtStart

interface.comment: light barrier at the end of the belt
interface.name: boxAtEnd

interface.comment: clears a jam and the box count
interface.name: resetButton

interface.comment: how long the box has been travelling
interface.name: travel

interface.comment: boxes per minute: a function block written in ST
interface.name: rate

networks.comment: Start/stop: start holds itself, stop and the emergency stop (both wired normally closed) always win
The belt motor follows "running", unless the jam detector tripped
A box should reach the end sensor within 8 s of passing the start sensor
networks.rung: boxAtStart /boxAtEnd {TON travel, PT := T#8s, ET => travelTime} => S:jammed

networks.comment: The operator clears the jam with the reset button, once the end sensor is free again
Count boxes: one per rising edge of the end sensor
networks.rung: boxAtEnd {R_TRIG arrived} {CTU boxCount, R := resetButton, PV := 100, CV => boxes} => batchFull

networks.comment: The warning lamp blinks while jammed: two timers, each starting the other

networks.rung: jammed blinkOn.Q {TON blinkOff, PT := T#500ms} => blinkPhase

networks.comment: Boxes per minute, from the ST block BoxRate; tooFast lights above 30
networks.rung: boxAtEnd {BoxRate rate, limit := 30, perMinute => boxesPerMinute} => tooFast
